notes.title: Becoming Free to Play
notes.content:
[b]Crossroads of Helmia is becoming free-to-play on 8 February![/b]

Crossroads of Helmia was released over two years ago, and its peak interest was at launch. Since then, however, there has been little activity in player engagement. Therefore, to allow more people to experience the world of Crossroads of Helmia, the game will transition to free-to-play starting 8 February.

Regards, Filip.

[b][u][h2]FAQ[/h2][/u][/b]
[h3][b]Q) Does this affect users who already purchased the game?[/b] [/h3]
Existing users will retain full access to the game, and your previous purchases will remain unchanged. 
[h3][b]Q) Are there any more planned updates to the game?[/b][/h3]
No, there are no planned updates for the game at the moment. The only change is that the game is becoming free-to-play. 
[h3][b]Q) Will the game have in-game purchases when becoming free?[/b][/h3] 
No, the game will remain as is, with no in-game purchases or advertisements
